profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer who enjoys Scala, functional programming, and building the simplest solution that gets the job done well. Always looking for ways to maximize automation and make practical use of AI throughout the development process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building and leading the adoption of a shared application testing and automation framework used across multiple enterprise development teams, including the tooling, documentation, and training needed to support it. Also developing internal dashboards and APIs for running and monitoring automated tests, while working with application, server, and infrastructure teams on Ansible automation, Grafana monitoring, PostgreSQL, and broader observability and deployment improvements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading the technical direction of a small startup, making architecture and technology decisions while building and maintaining the full-stack application. Developing primarily with Scala and the JVM, PostgreSQL, and modern web technologies, while also managing cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability, authentication, and other production systems that support the platform. Driving engineering automation and AI-assisted development workflows to automate testing, development, and operational tasks across the platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed web and mobile applications that interfaced with physical IoT devices, working across projects in domains including healthcare and geophysics. Worked across the full stack, including application development, device integrations, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, and CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and tested full-stack web applications using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, AngularJS, and React. Built automated test coverage and worked with AWS services including Lambda and SQS to support large-scale PDF generation and accessibility reporting.
